instruction: A cheeky cartoon Venus flytrap sprouting from a chunky terracotta pot, with two oversized bright-green traps lined by fat white teeth and one snapping open in a goofy grin. Glossy exaggerated highlights and a slight wobble in the stems give it a bouncy, animated-film look.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Venus Flytrap in a stylized-cartoon style. A cheeky cartoon Venus flytrap sprouting from a chunky terracotta pot, with two oversized bright-green traps lined by fat white teeth and one snapping open in a goofy grin. Glossy exaggerated highlights and a slight wobble in the stems give it a bouncy, animated-film look. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
